verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms n8n retains execution history and lets developers see data flowing in/out of each node for debugging (n8n-comm-8), and docs claim traceability of each step on the canvas (n8n-docs-2). However, no evidence explicitly documents the 'pin data' feature or a dedicated test-run/inspect UI workflow, so the specific 'pinned data' half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of pin-data functionality, a walkthrough of test-run mode before going live, and independent hands-on confirmation of that specific feature.
